explanation: Mathematics marks: Amit (90) + Bela (60) + Chetan (95) + Divya (88) + Esha (75) + Farhan (80) = 488. Average = 488 / 6 = 81.333... which rounds to 81.33. Option B assumes an average of 80, which is incorrect.

question:
Study the table below showing monthly rainfall in four cities (in mm) from January to April and answer the question.

City | January | February | March | April
Delhi | 20 | 15 | 12 | 8
Mumbai | 2 | 1 | 5 | 25
Kolkata | 18 | 22 | 35 | 50
Chennai | 40 | 30 | 15 | 10

Q. In Mumbai, what is the percentage increase in rainfall from March to April?
explanation: Mumbai rainfall in March = 5 mm, in April = 25 mm. Increase = 25 - 5 = 20 mm. Percentage increase = (Increase / Original value) * 100 = (20 / 5) * 100 = 4 * 100 = 400%. Option A is incorrect as it calculates the multiplier instead of percentage increase.

शहर | जनवरी | फरवरी | मार्च | अप्रैल
दिल्ली | 20 | 15 | 12 | 8
मुंबई | 2 | 1 | 5 | 25
कोलकाता | 18 | 22 | 35 | 50
चेन्नई | 40 | 30 | 15 | 10

Q. मुंबई में, मार्च से अप्रैल तक वर्षा में प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या है?
explanation_hi: मार्च में मुंबई की वर्षा = 5 मिमी, अप्रैल में = 25 मिमी। वृद्धि = 25 - 5 = 20 मिमी। प्रतिशत वृद्धि = (वृद्धि / मूल मान) * 100 = (20 / 5) * 100 = 400%। विकल्प A गलत है क्योंकि यह प्रतिशत वृद्धि के बजाय गुणक की गणना करता है।

question:
Study the table showing the number of cars sold (in thousands) by five companies over four years and answer the question.

Company | 2021 | 2022 | 2023 | 2024
Alpha | 45 | 50 | 60 | 75
Beta | 30 | 35 | 40 | 50
Gamma | 60 | 55 | 50 | 45
Delta | 20 | 25 | 35 | 40
Omega | 50 | 60 | 70 | 80

Q. Which company recorded the highest percentage growth in car sales from 2021 to 2024?
explanation: Percentage growth from 2021 to 2024 for each company: Alpha = (75-45)/45 = 66.67%; Beta = (50-30)/30 = 66.67%; Gamma = (45-60)/60 = -25%; Delta = (40-20)/20 = 100%; Omega = (80-50)/50 = 60%. Delta has the highest percentage growth at 100%. Alpha is a distractor with high absolute growth but lower percentage increase.
